purpose: Evaluate a larger unadapted Qwen writer on allocated free CPU; no paid resources or GPU identity/quota workarounds
runtime_preparation: Changed from source-build 0.3.37 to the maintainer's official CPU wheel 0.3.36 before any model development output was obtained; inference policy and frozen cases unchanged
development_cases: dev.json, four previously exposed cases only
policy_selection: Use the frozen English writing policy with its three AI-authored Saudi examples. Test greedy first; only if it fails development may test temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, seed 3407. Select only a configuration with all four development cases strictly sendable. No tuning against the fresh holdout.
earlier_holdout: Already exposed; cannot count as unseen evidence for this writer
strict_pass: All three listed meaning requirements, no invented fact/excuse/promise, correct roles/gender, and natural sendable Saudi text without factual or grammatical repair. Minor orthographic differences alone do not fail.
reviewer: Assistant assessment, not independent human validation
decision_if_failed: Keep pilot incumbent, publish actual unsuccessful evidence; do not claim a trained Saudi response adapter for this base writer
